semantic_fragments.content: ME equipment complied with its specifications and all requirements of the standard when operated in normal use within temperature +5°C to +40°C, relative humidity range of 15% to 90% non-condensing (not requiring a water vapour partial pressure greater than 50 hPa), and an atmospheric pressure range of 700 hPa to 1060 hPa. For a more restricted range, the operating temperature is 10°C to 40°C, justified in the risk management file and described in the 'Product A specifications' section of the User's Manual.

ME equipment classification for home healthcare environment: classified as class II and internally powered; not provided with a functional earth terminal; equipped with Type BF applied parts. No permanently installed equipment. Classification per IEC 60601-1-11:2015+A1:2020 Clause 6 and IEC 60601-1 Sub-clause 6.2.

Transit-operable equipment requirement (Clause 4.2.3.2): Transit-operable equipment with a stated wider range of continuous environmental operation conditions shall maintain basic safety and essential performance in the presence of condensation and thermal shock from rapid changes in environmental temperature and humidity during intended use. This clause is N/A as the product is not transit-operable ME equipment.

Accessibility determination per Clause 5 (in addition to IEC 60601-1 Sub-clause 5.9.2.1): Accessible parts identified by inspection and testing as necessary. When in doubt, the small finger probe of Fig 1 is applied in a bent or straight position for all positions of the ME equipment in normal use. Opening of access covers and removal of parts (lamps, fuses, fuse holders) is N/A as no such parts and no access covers exist.
